content.short: Onchain art project that changes every time it's refreshed.
content.description: The Refresh, created by ThisCrazyLife, is a JavaScript based art project. It was the first fully interactive onchain art project that changes every time it's refreshed. With each refresh the design changes and moves to a different location on the canvas. The background gradients also change their angle and spread across the canvas when refreshed. Between those two changing combinations you will never come across the same image twice.
content.meta: Find out about The Refresh (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
